en.headline: ICAC survey finds 99.2 per cent of respondents had no personal encounter with corruption
en.dek: The 2025 annual survey of about 1,500 people recorded the highest such figure on record and a mean tolerance score of 0.3 out of 10.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption released findings from its 2025 annual survey on Thursday, showing that 99.2 per cent of respondents said they had not personally encountered corruption in the past year — the highest percentage recorded in the survey series.

An independent research agency conducted household interviews with about 1,500 people between March and May this year. On a 0-to-10 scale where 0 means total intolerance, the mean score for tolerance of corruption was 0.3. A further 97.9 per cent of respondents said keeping Hong Kong corruption-free was important to the city’s development. A majority indicated they would report corruption if they came across it.

The ICAC said the results reflected an integrity culture that had taken root and high public awareness. It pledged to continue handling every complaint in accordance with the law through its three-pronged approach of enforcement, prevention and education.

zh.headline: 廉署調查顯示99.2%受訪者過去一年未親歷貪污 創紀錄
zh.dek: 2025年周年民調訪問約1500人，貪污容忍度平均僅0.3分，97.9%認為社會廉潔對香港發展重要。
body: 廉政公署今日公佈2025年周年民意調查結果，99.2%受訪者表示過去一年沒有親身遇過貪污，是有相關紀錄以來最高百分比。
廉署委託獨立研究機構於今年3月至5月以家訪形式訪問約1500名市民。以0分代表完全不可以容忍、10分代表完全可以容忍，受訪者對貪污容忍度平均分為0.3。另外97.9%受訪者認為社會廉潔對香港發展重要，大部分表示若遇到貪污會挺身舉報。
廉署表示結果反映廉潔文化植根香港，市民反貪意識極高。廉署承諾繼續依法處理每一宗投訴，並透過執法、防貪及教育三管齊下維護廉潔。
